dct_description_sm: PTTW data was obtained from the Oak Ridges Moraine Goundwater Program that in turn obtained it from the Ministry of Environment, Conservation and Parks. At the time of download, the data was last updated April 11th, 2022. Any permit that was active on April 11th, 2022 was assumed active for the purposes of this assessment. It was noted that the Caledon East and Palgrave municipal systems were not included in the download despite staff being aware that the system has operated continuously from the last Humber River Watershed Plan until present. The permit to take water for these two systems was obtained from the Provincial Source Protection Atlas.
